Mod support and known incompatibilities
What is synced, what causes trouble
Most MSCLoader mods work in co-op as long as they only do things for you. Those that add objects or vehicles the others must see need MWCoop to sync them: here is the list, and the mods to avoid.
Synced by MWCoop
Machtwagen 300D: doors, locking, sunroof, windows, A/C, engine.
Second Machtwagen: purchase, color, plate, tuning.
RAM 1500: driving, key, lights, doors, lot purchase, camper shell, paint, radio.
Cheatbox++: the items and parts it spawns (not time, weather or teleporting).
Spare Parts Seller: the parts you buy.
Jonne Food System: food and drinks.
Utility Tow Cart: the cart, pulled by hand or hitched.
Jack Stands (with OASIS): the stands under the car.
Suitcase: the suitcase.
Nothing to sync (work as they are)
BetterFPS, NOP: picture settings, each player their own.
Autoload (skips the menu): kept on your side, never sent to guests (their game would load its old save before yours).
Not recommended: known bugs
MOP (Modern Optimization Plugin): it turns off and on cars and objects far from you, which MWCoop follows live. Cars that fly, teleport or desync. Remove it to play co-op.
Toiveradio Enhanced: each player picks their own songs and ads on Toivoradio, you don't hear the same thing. Without it, the radio is the same for everyone.
A mod missing from this list? Try it: if it adds an object the others can't see, say so on Discord (suggestions channel) with its Nexus link.
Punches between players

Off by default. The host allows them in Game and sharing (\"Punches between players\"); their guests follow that choice. The game's punch hits a player on foot right in front of you: they step back a little, and on the 5th punch within 20 s they die (then respawn as usual).
